captions.detailed: An adjustable weight bench featuring a low-profile black tubular steel frame, a split backrest and seat pad, a rear support link, and front transport wheels. The thick, rectangular black leather pads are mounted on individual support brackets. A bright red pop-pin angle selector knob is positioned underneath the backrest on the side. The backrest and seat pads pivot on separate transverse hinges, the rear support link rotates on a lower frame pivot, the front wheels spin continuously on their axle, and the red pop-pin translates prismatically along its local axis.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of an adjustable weight bench with a low tubular steel frame, split backrest and seat pads, a rear support link, and front transport wheels. Incorporate a red pop-pin angle selector knob under the backrest, and define joints for the pivoting pads, rotating support link, spinning transport wheels, and a sliding pop-pin.
captions.factory: Construct the main frame using box and cylinder primitives for the tubular base, axle, and cross-members. Create the backrest and seat pads from thick box shapes. Model the support brackets, links, and wheels using cylinder and box primitives. Define the joints using an ArticulatedObject builder: specify revolute joints for the backrest, seat, and rear support link pivots, continuous joints for the front transport wheels on their axle, and a prismatic joint for the red pop-pin selector knob.
